about: Hand-labelled tool declarations used to score the capability inference in mcpmap/taxonomy.py. Labels are the authors' judgement of what capability a tool would need in order to do what its declaration says. Declarations are written to resemble real published MCP tools, including awkward and ambiguous cases; a label set of only easy cases would overstate the inference's accuracy. Disputes about individual labels are welcome as issues.

labels.description: Read a file from the local filesystem and return its contents.

labels.description: Write content to a file on disk, creating it if needed.
